instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: The supervisor confirms that the (27) ........ does not count towards the word limit.
items.evidence: The raw data goes in the appendix, and the appendix doesn't count towards your word limit.
items.explanation: All the raw data goes at the back of the report; the supervisor confirms that this section is kept outside the word limit.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Every reading the students took should be placed in an (27) ........, which is left out of the word count.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The raw data goes in the appendix, and the appendix doesn't count towards your word limit.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk esdizim obeginin ucundaydi: belirsiz tanimlik 'an' adayi unluyle baslayan bir sozcuge kilitliyor, 'her olcumun icine konuldugu yer' + 'kelime sayisina girmez' cercevesi de tek adayi ayakta birakiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Tanimlik 'an'dan 'the'ye cevrildi (unlu kilidi kalkti) ve 'her olcum oraya konur' ipucu cumleden cikarildi. Kalan cerceve tek basina okununca bibliography, references, footnotes, abstract gibi bircok adayi ayni derecede mumkun kiliyor; dogru sozcuk ancak danismanin sesteki cumlesiyle secilebiliyor. Cevap, accepted_variants, answer_point_id ve turn_index degismedi.
yeniden_uretim.sessiz_sinama_son: Son sessiz sinama (2026-08-18, uc bagimsiz tur, senaryo GORULMEDEN, ayni turlarda dokunulmamis kalemlerin taban orani %15): 1/3 (appendices — tam esleme degil, appendix, references).
yeniden_uretim.kalan_risk: Uc partide toplam 9 turun 2'sinde tam dogru yazildi (ayrica bir turda 'appendices'). Kalinti sozcukseldir: 'kelime sayisina girmeyen bolum' kavramini Ingilizcede karsilayan aday sayisi az. Cerceve yine de eski halinden cok daha acik — eski cerceve uc turda da 3/3 tutturuluyordu, simdi bibliography ve references rakip olarak cikiyor.

items.prompt: This year the report must not run to more than (28) ........ words.
items.evidence: It's two thousand five hundred now
items.explanation: Last year's group had a limit of three thousand words; this year's limit is two thousand five hundred, and this is a maximum, not a target.

items.prompt: The finished report has to be handed in on the (29) ........ at midday.
items.evidence: The final report is due on the nineteenth, at midday
items.explanation: The twelfth in the student's notebook is the draft date from the old schedule; the finished report is due on the nineteenth, at midday.

items.prompt: Along with a cover sheet, the students have to attach the signed (30) ........ at the back.
items.evidence: the signed risk assessment attached at the back
items.explanation: Alongside the cover sheet, a signed risk assessment is also required; without it, the supervisor cannot assess the fieldwork.
